title: Postmaster, backends, shared memory
caption: The postmaster forks one backend per connection; backends and helper processes share memory, and the helpers flush it to disk.

title: Life of one connection
caption: Follow the numbers: connect, fork, startup packet, authenticate, query, then exit.

title: Startup packet and messages
caption: The startup packet has no type letter, but every later message starts with one.
